title: Ezekiel Chapter 45 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Ezekiel chapter 45 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Ezekiel Chapter 45 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Ezekiel Chapter 45.

questions.question: In Ezekiel 45, which of the following appears FIRST in the chapter?
options: The holy portion of the land for the priests
The length and breadth of the land to be divided
The prince's portion on both sides of the holy portion
questions.correctAnswer: The length and breadth of the land to be divided
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:1 first mentions dividing the land by lot for inheritance and the measurements of the land.

questions.question: According to Ezekiel 45:1, what is the length of the land offered as an holy portion unto the LORD?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:1 states the length shall be the length of five and twenty thousand reeds.

questions.question: What shape is the sanctuary described in Ezekiel 45:2?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:2 says the sanctuary shall be square round about, five hundred in length and breadth.

questions.question: How wide are the suburbs around the sanctuary as given in Ezekiel 45:2?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:2 specifies fifty cubits round about for the suburbs of the sanctuary.

questions.question: Who is the holy portion of the land given to according to Ezekiel 45:4?
options: The priests the ministers of the sanctuary
questions.correctAnswer: The priests the ministers of the sanctuary
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:4 states the holy portion of the land shall be for the priests the ministers of the sanctuary.

questions.question: What is the length and breadth of the land the Levites shall have for themselves as given in Ezekiel 45:5?
options: Five and twenty thousand by ten thousand
questions.correctAnswer: Five and twenty thousand by ten thousand
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:5 states the Levites shall have five and twenty thousand of length and ten thousand of breadth for themselves.

questions.question: How many chambers shall the Levites have in their possession according to Ezekiel 45:5?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:5 states the Levites shall have possession for twenty chambers.

questions.question: What are the dimensions of the city’s possession as mentioned in Ezekiel 45:6?
options: Five thousand broad and five and twenty thousand long
Ten thousand broad and five thousand long
Five and twenty thousand broad and five thousand long
Ten thousand broad and ten thousand long
questions.correctAnswer: Five thousand broad and five and twenty thousand long
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:6 specifies the possession of the city shall be five thousand broad and five and twenty thousand long.

questions.question: To whom shall the possession of the city belong according to Ezekiel 45:6?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:6 says the possession of the city shall be for the whole house of Israel.

questions.question: From which directions does the prince have a portion before the oblation of the holy portion and the possession of the city, according to Ezekiel 45:7?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:7 details the prince's portion is from the west side westward and from the east side eastward.

questions.question: According to Ezekiel 45:8, what will happen to the princes in regard to oppressing the people?
options: They will oppress the people more
They shall no more oppress my people
The text does not mention oppression
questions.correctAnswer: They shall no more oppress my people
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:8 states that the princes shall no more oppress God's people.

questions.question: What does the Lord command the princes of Israel to remove according to Ezekiel 45:9?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:9 commands the princes to remove violence and spoil, and to execute judgment and justice.

questions.question: True or False: The holy portion of the land is described as holy in all the borders thereof round about.
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:1 says the holy portion shall be holy in all the borders thereof round about.

questions.question: True or False: The sanctuary and the most holy place are located within the land measured as five and twenty thousand by ten thousand.
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:3 states the sanctuary and the most holy place shall be within the land measured as five and twenty thousand by ten thousand.

questions.question: True or False: Ezekiel 45 says the length of the prince’s portion shall be from north to south.
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:7 states the prince’s portion is from west side westward and east side eastward, not north to south.

medium.title: Ezekiel Chapter 45 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Ezekiel Chapter 45 to real-life situations.

questions.question: What type of balances is mentioned in Ezekiel 45:10?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:10 states, 'Ye shall have just balances,' indicating the need for fairness in trade.

questions.question: What does Ezekiel 45:11 promise will happen if someone uses a just ephah?
questions.explanation: Using just measures aligns with God's standards, which brings blessing.

questions.question: How many gerahs are in one shekel according to Ezekiel 45:12?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:12 specifies, 'And the shekel shall be twenty gerahs,' defining the measurement.

questions.question: What type of offering is mentioned in Ezekiel 45:15?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:15 indicates that a lamb is to be used for a meat offering and other types of offerings.

questions.question: According to Ezekiel 45:14, how much oil should be offered?
options: One tenth part of a bath
questions.correctAnswer: One tenth part of a bath
questions.explanation: The verse states that the bath of oil to be offered is 'the tenth part of a bath out of the cor.'

questions.question: What does Ezekiel 45:16 say about the people's obligation?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:16 states, 'All the people of the land shall give this oblation for the prince in Israel.'

questions.question: What is the prince's responsibility according to Ezekiel 45:17?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:17 explains that the prince is to give various offerings, including burnt offerings.

questions.question: What is to be taken on the first day of the month according to Ezekiel 45:18?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:18 specifies, 'In the first month, in the first day of the month, thou shalt take a young bullock without blemish.'

questions.question: What is the purpose of the oblation mentioned in Ezekiel 45:13?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:13 discusses offerings intended to make reconciliation for the people.

questions.question: What does Ezekiel 45:9 urge the princes of Israel to do?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:9 commands princes to 'remove violence and spoil' from the people.

questions.question: What is promised regarding the land in Ezekiel 45:8?
options: It will be given to foreigners
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:8 assures that princes shall no more oppress the people.

questions.question: What is the size of the holy portion of the land as described in Ezekiel 45:1?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:1 describes the length of the holy portion as 'five and twenty thousand reeds.'

questions.question: The offerings in Ezekiel 45:17 are meant for what purpose?
questions.explanation: The offerings are specified in Ezekiel 45:17 for making reconciliation for the house of Israel.

questions.question: Ezekiel 45:12 defines the maneh as containing twenty shekels.
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:12 states a maneh contains twenty shekels, but does not define it solely by that number.

questions.question: The ephah and the bath are mentioned as having different measures in Ezekiel 45:11.
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:11 states that the ephah and the bath shall be of one measure.

hard.title: Ezekiel Chapter 45 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Ezekiel Chapter 45.

questions.question: What shall the priest do with the blood of the sin offering according to Ezekiel 45:19?
options: Put it upon the posts of the house and the four corners of the altar
Pour it out at the gate of the city
questions.correctAnswer: Put it upon the posts of the house and the four corners of the altar
questions.explanation: The priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering, and put it upon the posts of the house, and upon the four corners of the settle of the altar, and upon the posts of the gate of the inner court. (Ezekiel 45:19)

questions.question: Who is to prepare a bullock for a sin offering on the fourteenth day of the first month according to Ezekiel 45:22?
questions.explanation: Upon that day shall the prince prepare for himself and for all the people of the land a bullock for a sin offering. (Ezekiel 45:22)

questions.question: How many bullocks and rams are to be prepared daily during the feast according to Ezekiel 45:23?
questions.explanation: And seven days of the feast he shall prepare a burnt offering to the LORD, seven bullocks and seven rams without blemish daily the seven days. (Ezekiel 45:23)

questions.question: What kind of bread is to be eaten during the Passover according to Ezekiel 45:21?
questions.explanation: In the first month, in the fourteenth day of the month, ye shall have the passover, a feast of seven days; unleavened bread shall be eaten. (Ezekiel 45:21)

questions.question: What is to be offered as a meat offering along with the bullock and ram according to Ezekiel 45:24?
options: An ephah for a bullock and ram
questions.correctAnswer: An ephah for a bullock and ram
questions.explanation: And he shall prepare a meat offering of an ephah for a bullock, and an ephah for a ram, and an hin of oil for an ephah. (Ezekiel 45:24)

questions.question: What does the Hebrew word 'oblation' in Ezekiel 45:13 mean?
questions.explanation: The term 'oblation' refers to an offering made to God, particularly in the context of sacrifices for atonement. (Ezekiel 45:13)

questions.question: Which literary technique is primarily used in Ezekiel 45:9 where God commands the princes of Israel?
questions.explanation: The command to remove violence and execute justice uses repetition to emphasize the importance of these principles. (Ezekiel 45:9)

questions.question: Which other Bible passage connects to the theme of reconciliation found in Ezekiel 45:20?
questions.explanation: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness, connecting to the theme of reconciliation in Ezekiel 45:20.

questions.question: Which other Bible passage fulfills the command for offerings found in Ezekiel 45:23?
questions.explanation: By the which will we are sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all, showing the fulfillment of sacrificial offerings. (Ezekiel 45:23)

questions.question: What comes before Ezekiel 45:19?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:18 precedes Ezekiel 45:19, describing the actions required on the first day of the month. (Ezekiel 45:18)

questions.question: In Ezekiel 45:25, what is to be done in the seventh month?
options: The same as in the first month
questions.correctAnswer: The same as in the first month
questions.explanation: In the seventh month, in the fifteenth day of the month, shall he do the like in the feast of the seven days. (Ezekiel 45:25)

questions.question: The Hebrew word 'sin' in Ezekiel 45:22 refers to what?
questions.explanation: The term 'sin' in this context often refers to a transgression against divine law, highlighting the need for atonement. (Ezekiel 45:22)

questions.question: The offerings described in Ezekiel 45:22-24 serve what primary purpose?
questions.explanation: The offerings are intended to make reconciliation for the house of Israel, as indicated throughout the passage. (Ezekiel 45:22-24)

questions.question: True or False: The Passover is celebrated on the fifteenth day of the first month according to Ezekiel 45:21.
questions.explanation: In the first month, in the fourteenth day of the month, ye shall have the passover. (Ezekiel 45:21)

questions.question: True or False: The meat offering for the prince includes a hin of oil according to Ezekiel 45:24.
questions.explanation: The hin of oil is specified as part of the meat offering for an ephah of bullock and ram, not for the prince himself. (Ezekiel 45:24)

theological.title: Ezekiel Chapter 45 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Ezekiel Chapter 45 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What doctrine does Ezekiel 45:4 teach about the sanctification of God's servants?
options: The priests are set apart as holy ministers serving God in a dedicated space
All Israelites equally share the holy portion of the land without distinction
Only the Levites receive land for their ministry, excluding priests
The holy portion is a temporary allocation for the priests
questions.correctAnswer: The priests are set apart as holy ministers serving God in a dedicated space
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:4 states that the holy portion of the land shall be for the priests who minister to the LORD, indicating their sanctification and dedicated role in serving God.

questions.question: What doctrine concerning divine justice does Ezekiel 45:9 teach?
options: God commands the princes to remove oppression and practice justice
God permits rulers to exercise violence to maintain order
Judgment is left to human discretion without divine oversight
Exactions and violence are acceptable if done for the people's good
questions.correctAnswer: God commands the princes to remove oppression and practice justice
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:9 instructs the princes to cease violence and spoil, and to execute judgment and justice, reflecting God's demand for righteous leadership.

questions.question: What doctrine about covenant worship is taught in Ezekiel 45:17?
options: The prince is responsible for leading sacrificial offerings to maintain reconciliation
The people alone are responsible for offerings without leadership involvement
Sacrificial offerings are abolished in the new covenant era
Only priests perform offerings, excluding princes
questions.correctAnswer: The prince is responsible for leading sacrificial offerings to maintain reconciliation
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:17 explains that the prince shall prepare sin offerings, burnt offerings, and peace offerings to make reconciliation for Israel, highlighting his covenantal role in worship.

questions.question: Which divine attribute does Ezekiel 45:1 specifically demonstrate?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:1 describes the land set apart as 'holy in all the borders thereof,' demonstrating God's attribute of holiness in designating sacred space.

questions.question: Which divine attribute is highlighted in Ezekiel 45:8 regarding the prince's land inheritance?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:8 states the prince shall no longer oppress the people, showing God's justice in protecting His people through righteous leadership.

questions.question: How does Ezekiel 45 prepare for the theme of Messianic kingship found in later Scripture?
options: By assigning the prince responsibility for sacrifices and land, it prefigures Christ's mediatorial kingship and priestly role
By denying any role for a prince, it emphasizes purely theocracy without monarchy
By focusing solely on the priests, it excludes royal authority from worship
By rejecting sacrifices, it anticipates a non-sacrificial worship
questions.correctAnswer: By assigning the prince responsibility for sacrifices and land, it prefigures Christ's mediatorial kingship and priestly role
questions.explanation: The chapter's allocation of duties and land to the prince foreshadows the Messianic king who combines royal and priestly functions, as seen in Hebrews and Psalms.

questions.question: What redemptive-historical connection does Ezekiel 45:21-23 have with the Passover instituted in Exodus?
options: It reaffirms the Passover as a central covenant feast with prescribed sacrifices for communal atonement
It replaces the Passover with a new feast unrelated to Israel's history
It abolishes the Passover and forbids lamb sacrifices
It restricts Passover celebrations to priests only
questions.correctAnswer: It reaffirms the Passover as a central covenant feast with prescribed sacrifices for communal atonement
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:21-23 commands the Passover feast with specific offerings, connecting to the Exodus institution and maintaining covenant continuity.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do Ezekiel 45:10 and 45:11 teach about God's standards for justice and measurement?
options: God requires just balances and measures to ensure fairness and prevent exploitation
God permits flexibility in weights and measures depending on circumstances
God ignores commerce and legal standards in favor of ritual purity only
God's justice is unrelated to economic dealings
questions.correctAnswer: God requires just balances and measures to ensure fairness and prevent exploitation
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:10-11 emphasizes the use of just balances, ephah, and bath, teaching that God's justice extends to economic fairness and honest measures.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do Ezekiel 45:18 and 45:19 teach about purification and atonement in the sanctuary?
options: Ritual cleansing and application of atoning blood are necessary for sanctifying the sanctuary
Physical cleansing alone suffices to sanctify holy places
The sanctuary requires no purification after sin offerings
Atonement is symbolic and not connected to blood rituals
questions.correctAnswer: Ritual cleansing and application of atoning blood are necessary for sanctifying the sanctuary
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:18-19 describes taking a young bullock for sin offering and applying its blood to sanctuary posts, teaching the necessity of blood atonement for sanctification.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do Ezekiel 45:13 and 45:14 teach about the nature of offerings required by God?
options: Offerings must be precise, measured, and include grain and oil as integral parts
Offerings are arbitrary and can be given in any quantity or form
Only animal sacrifices are required, excluding grain or oil
Offerings are symbolic and not bound by measurement
questions.correctAnswer: Offerings must be precise, measured, and include grain and oil as integral parts
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:13-14 specifies exact portions of wheat, barley, and oil as oblations, indicating God's demand for precise and comprehensive offerings.

questions.question: Sceptics claim Ezekiel 45:15-16 teaches that the prince exploits the people by demanding excessive offerings. What does Ezekiel 45:15-16 actually teach?
options: The prince receives a portion of offerings as part of covenant worship, not exploitation
The prince arbitrarily taxes the people beyond God's commands
Offerings to the prince are voluntary gifts, not required
The prince's portion replaces offerings to God
questions.correctAnswer: The prince receives a portion of offerings as part of covenant worship, not exploitation
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:15-16 explains the prince's portion is given by all the people as an oblation, integrated into worship for reconciliation, not oppression.

questions.question: What doctrine regarding priestly and Levitical roles is taught in Ezekiel 45:5?
options: Levitical ministers receive land for dwellings separate from the priests' holy portion
Levites and priests share the exact same land inheritance
Levites have no land possession and live among the people
Only priests receive land, Levites serve without property
questions.correctAnswer: Levitical ministers receive land for dwellings separate from the priests' holy portion
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:5 assigns the Levites a possession for twenty chambers, distinct from the priests' holy portion, indicating differentiated roles and inheritance.

questions.question: Which divine attribute does Ezekiel 45:20 specifically demonstrate in God's dealings with the erring?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:20 commands repeated sin offerings for those who err or are simple, showing God’s patient longsuffering toward human weakness.

questions.question: How does Ezekiel 45:6 contribute to the narrative arc of Israel’s restoration after exile?
options: It establishes a city possession for all Israel, symbolizing communal restoration and unity
It limits land to priests only, excluding the people
It abolishes the concept of tribal inheritance
It focuses on foreign nations receiving land in Israel
questions.correctAnswer: It establishes a city possession for all Israel, symbolizing communal restoration and unity
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:6 sets aside land for the city for the whole house of Israel, representing restoration and unity in the promised land.

questions.question: What combined theological insight do Ezekiel 45:22 and 45:23 provide about the nature of sin and atonement in Israel’s worship?
options: Continuous offerings of sin and burnt sacrifices are required for ongoing reconciliation
One sacrifice is sufficient for all sin eternally
Sin offerings are symbolic and not necessary for forgiveness
Sacrifices are only for the priests and not the people
questions.correctAnswer: Continuous offerings of sin and burnt sacrifices are required for ongoing reconciliation
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 45:22-23 describes daily sacrifices during feast days, teaching the ongoing need for atonement and reconciliation.
